title: Water Preservation for Flow Cytometry
author: Melissa B Duhaime
materials: Using sterilized forceps, place a 20 um nylon net filter in the filter holder and tightly screw the filter holder together. 20um Nylon Net Filter Merck Millipore (EMD Millipore) Catalog #NY2002500

steps.title: Clean Filter Holders and Syringes
steps.instruction: Decontaminate Swinnex filter holders and syringes using bleach to prevent interference with flow cytometry.

substeps.instruction: Soak Swinnex filter holders (EMD Millipore, 25mm, Fisher Scientific #SX00 025 00) and syringes in 10% bleach for 1-24 hours.
Rinse thoroughly with MilliQ water until there is no hint of bleach smell, plus an additional one or two rinses.
Allow to dry completely or use immediately.
Aliquot 7.5 µL of 25% aqueous glutaraldehyde (EM Fisher Scientific #50-262-19) into each cryovial.
Store aliquoted glutaraldehyde at 4°C until use.

steps.title: Add Seawater Samples
steps.instruction: Transfer filtered seawater into the prepared cryovials.

substeps.instruction: Using a sterile 10-ml syringe and a prepared filter cartridge, aliquot 1.5 mL of 20 µm-filtered seawater sample into each cryovial.
Label cryovials with an ultra fine point Sharpie marker.

steps.title: Fix Samples
steps.instruction: Incubate the samples to allow for fixation.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature in the dark for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Freeze and Store Samples
steps.instruction: Preserve the fixed samples through cryogenic storage.

substeps.instruction: Snap-freeze the samples in liquid nitrogen.
